3	import (
4		"context"

9		storepb "github.com/usememos/memos/proto/gen/store"
10	)

12	// Visibility is the type of a visibility.
13	type Visibility string
14	
15	const (
16		// Public is the PUBLIC visibility.
17		Public Visibility = "PUBLIC"
18		// Protected is the PROTECTED visibility.
19		Protected Visibility = "PROTECTED"
20		// Private is the PRIVATE visibility.
21		Private Visibility = "PRIVATE"
22	)
23	
24	func (v Visibility) String() string {
25		switch v {
26		case Public:
27			return "PUBLIC"
28		case Protected:
29			return "PROTECTED"
30		default:
31			return "PRIVATE"
32		}
33	}
34	
35	type Memo struct {
36		// ID is the system generated unique identifier for the memo.
37		ID int32
38		// UID is the user defined unique identifier for the memo.
39		UID string
40	
41		// Standard fields
42		RowStatus RowStatus
43		CreatorID int32
44		CreatedTs int64
45		UpdatedTs int64
46	
47		// Domain specific fields
48		Content    string
49		Visibility Visibility
50		Pinned     bool
51		Payload    *storepb.MemoPayload
52	
53		// Composed fields
54		ParentUID *string
55	}
56	
57	type FindMemo struct {
58		ID  *int32
59		UID *string
60	
61		IDList  []int32
62		UIDList []string
63	
64		// Standard fields
65		RowStatus *RowStatus
66		CreatorID *int32
67	
68		// Domain specific fields
69		VisibilityList  []Visibility
70		ExcludeContent  bool
71		ExcludeComments bool
72		Filters         []string
73	
74		// Pagination
75		Limit  *int
76		Offset *int
77	
78		// Ordering
79		OrderByPinned    bool
80		OrderByUpdatedTs bool
81		OrderByTimeAsc   bool
82	}
83

85		Raw                *string
86		TagSearch          []string
87		HasLink            bool
88		HasTaskList        bool
89		HasCode            bool
90		HasIncompleteTasks bool
91	}
92	
93	type UpdateMemo struct {
94		ID         int32
95		UID        *string
96		CreatedTs  *int64
97		UpdatedTs  *int64
98		RowStatus  *RowStatus
99		Content    *string
100		Visibility *Visibility
101		Pinned     *bool
102		Payload    *storepb.MemoPayload
103	}

106		ID int32
107	}

109	func (s *Store) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, create *Memo) (*Memo, error) {
110		if !base.UIDMatcher.MatchString(create.UID) {
111			return nil, errors.New("invalid uid")
112		}
113		return s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
114	}
115	
116	func (s *Store) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, find *FindMemo) ([]*Memo, error) {
117		return s.driver.ListMemos(ctx, find)
118	}
119	
120	func (s *Store) GetMemo(ctx context.Context, find *FindMemo) (*Memo, error) {
121		list, err := s.ListMemos(ctx, find)
122		if err != nil {
123			return nil, err
124		}
125		if len(list) == 0 {
126			return nil, nil
127		}
128	
129		memo := list[0]
130		return memo, nil
131	}
132	
133	func (s *Store) UpdateMemo(ctx context.Context, update *UpdateMemo) error {
134		if update.UID != nil && !base.UIDMatcher.MatchString(*update.UID) {
135			return errors.New("invalid uid")
136		}
137		return s.driver.UpdateMemo(ctx, update)
138	}
139	
140	func (s *Store) DeleteMemo(ctx context.Context, delete *DeleteMemo) error {
141		// Clean up memo_relation records where this memo is either the source or target.
142		if err := s.driver.DeleteMemoRelation(ctx, &DeleteMemoRelation{MemoID: &delete.ID}); err != nil {
143			return err
144		}
145		if err := s.driver.DeleteMemoRelation(ctx, &DeleteMemoRelation{RelatedMemoID: &delete.ID}); err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		// Clean up attachments linked to this memo.
149		attachments, err := s.ListAttachments(ctx, &FindAttachment{MemoID: &delete.ID})
150		if err != nil {
151			return err
152		}
153		for _, attachment := range attachments {
154			if err := s.DeleteAttachment(ctx, &DeleteAttachment{ID: attachment.ID}); err != nil {
155				return err
156			}
157		}
158		return s.driver.DeleteMemo(ctx, delete)
159	}
